description: Prepare for recruitment at a Chinese state-owned enterprise (国企 / 央企), including its written test and interview: what these employers assess, the typical stages, answers that show fit and stability, and the questions to ask about the role. Use when asked 国企面试怎么准备, 央企校招, 国企笔试考什么, 国企和互联网怎么选, 国企面试问题, or prepare for a state-owned enterprise interview in China.
